verification_note: signal_claim(port) returns a real, non-negative port_id for the FIRST caller to claim a given port (this process becomes the primary); a SECOND signal_claim on the SAME port, from the same still-running process, correctly returns -1 -- confirming the underlying tcp_try_listen genuinely detects the port is already held, the same free 'is an instance already running' detector the file's own header describes; signal_poll on an idle claimed port with a short timeout returns the empty string (no message arrived) rather than hanging or erroring
